summary: Solstice Advanced Materials Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the mutual termination of its Agreement and Plan of Merger with Element Solutions Inc., originally entered July 6, 2026. The Termination Agreement, dated August 27, 2026, ends the merger pursuant to Section 8.1(a) and releases both parties from related claims, with no termination payments due. No price, premium, or advisor details are provided. The deal, which would have involved Solstice's wholly-owned merger subsidiaries, is now void. Watch for potential renegotiation or new strategic alternatives.
